name: queuebit-contracts-devnet-tests-leanpool
description: The post-quantum everyday key end to end on the PUBLIC alt-mempool devnet: a QueueBit account, its Vault (C13, Path B) installs a LeanPoolHotSigner, a leanSPHINCS-signed payment goes through a LeanPool node into the alt mempool and is mined; the batch's STARK is verified (bun; standalone, not a pnpm workspace package).
